name: wds_vtab-dsprites_label_x_position
description: A synthetic vision benchmark based on the dSprites dataset that measures a model's ability to predict the horizontal (x) position of a simple sprite. It evaluates how well learned visual representations capture simple spatial attributes under linear probes or lightweight classifiers. The task is primarily used in representation-learning and VTAB-style evaluations to assess feature alignment with low-level factors of variation.
reputation: Niche but commonly used in representation-learning and VTAB-style suites for probing low-level visual factors.
